column3: “From their own heart” is rendered “from their own inspiration.”
“On the house of Israel” is rendered “around.”
“Worthlessness” is rendered “falsehood,” and “waited” as “hope for the fulfillment.”
“Because and by cause” is rendered “definitely because,” and “he is building a wall” as “when anyone builds a wall.”
“Whitewash” is a rare word; NASB has “plaster it over with whitewash.”
“From their own heart” is rendered “from their own inspiration.”
“Joints of my hands” is rendered “all wrists”; NASB supplies “magic.” The words are rare.
“Bands” is rendered “magic bands,” and “for birds” as “as birds.”
